title: Small directed supersets from small cofinal subset families
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$; sets and indexing categories called small belong to $\mathcal U$, and all Hom sets are small. An infinite cardinal $\eta$ is regular when a union of fewer than $\eta$ sets of cardinality less than $\eta$ has cardinality less than $\eta$. A category is $\eta$-filtered when every diagram with fewer than $\eta$ morphisms admits a cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; for a poset this means that every subset of cardinality less than $\eta$, including the empty subset, has an upper bound. An object is $\eta$-presentable when its Hom functor preserves small $\eta$-filtered colimits. Let $\sigma<\tau$ be infinite regular cardinals. Suppose that for every small set $T$ of cardinality less than $\tau$, the poset $\mathcal P_{<\sigma}(T)$ of subsets of $T$ of cardinality less than $\sigma$, ordered by inclusion, has a cofinal subset $E_T$ of cardinality less than $\tau$. Cofinal means that every member of $\mathcal P_{<\sigma}(T)$ is contained in some member of $E_T$. Let $I$ be a small $\sigma$-filtered partially ordered set and $S\subseteq I$ have cardinality less than $\tau$. Then there is a subset $J\subseteq I$ containing $S$, of cardinality less than $\tau$, that is $\sigma$-filtered in its inherited order.
